text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — planning a mini canary for model Argos-4b-v2 tomorrow 10:00am PST. Goal: smoke basic chat flows, measure p50/p95, and ensure fallback to Argos-4b-v1 if we see regressions. Window ~30m. Who can own smoke + rollback?
Alex Rivera: I can own smoke checks. I’ll run the prompt set and watch Console charts. @deploy-bot can you reserve the canary slot? :+1:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary slot reserved: argos-4b-v2-canary @ 2026-04-12T10:00:00-08:00 by alex.r — runbook: /runbooks/model-canary — notify channels: #eng-ml, #eng-oncall
Sam O'Neill: Irene — can you run latency/memory validation on Dedicated pool? quick helper script: ```bash
# smoke runner
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"argos-4b-v2","input":"<smoke-prompt-set>"}'
```
Irene Gupta: On it. Will run smoke prompts + KV cache warmup check. I’ll post p50/p95 and mem usage ~10m after start.
Maya Chen: Rollback plan: if >5% error rate OR p95 latency >400ms for 2 consecutive 5m buckets, flip alias to argos-4b-v1 and notify oncall. Rollback command: `rwctl models alias set argos-default argos-4b-v1` — please be ready to run that.
Tariq Khan: Added a fast deterministic check to staging to validate outputs for 12 golden prompts. Note: quantized variant shows slightly different top-1 for two prompts, flagged for review.
Alex Rivera: Also want to apply pin strategy after smoke: canary weight 10%, stable 90%. Sam — can you confirm the catalog API call to apply pins?
Sam O'Neill: API call I’ll use at T+2m after green: `POST /catalog/pins` payload `{ "model": "argos-4b-v2", "weight": 0.1, "target": "canary" }`. I’ll push and post response.
Irene Gupta: Smoke results so far: KV warm, p95 ~320ms, memory stable. One mismatch observed in ranking for eval prompt #4 (difference vs v1). Tagged @Maya Chen with sample outputs.
Maya Chen: Thanks — I’ll run a quick quality diff. If quality delta > 2 BLEU points (or equivalent QA flag), we hold. If within threshold, proceed with pin and monitor for 20m.
Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: I’ll be around for T+10 to watch logs and handle rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-04-12T10:00:10-08:00; monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/monitor/argos-4b-v2-canary — alert rules enabled: p95>400ms, error_rate>5%
Maya Chen: Final plan noted. If anything goes sideways, run the rollback command, alert #eng-oncall, and we’ll revert the pin. Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.
